summary: Agent confirmed a refund without performing required full identity verification for refunds. No other policy violations found in the provided transcript excerpts.

findings.quote: ok, would you give me your full name or account ID
findings.explanation: The agent only asked for the customer's full name or account ID. For refunds the policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID) before processing refunds or returns.

findings.quote: absolutely, the $12 charge will land back on your card within a couple of days. you're all set.
findings.explanation: The agent confirms that a refund has been made or will be processed, but the transcript contains no evidence the required full verification (username, email and order ID) was completed or that the agent pulled up the account before taking this action.
